list: Stay in character at all times — let your character think, react, and speak as they would.
Give others room to roleplay — don’t rush scenes, let stories breathe.
Actions speak louder than words — use emotes and descriptions to show what your character does.
Don’t force RP — create opportunities, not outcomes.
Losing is part of RP — let your character fail sometimes, it makes stories better.
Don’t break immersion — avoid using OOC unless absolutely needed.
Remember: your character isn’t you — keep emotions separate.
Build your story through relationships — talk, interact, form connections.
Give meaningful reactions — even small events can shape your character.
Don’t chase action — slice-of-life moments often create the best roleplay.

list.a: Our server focuses on immersive roleplay with custom systems, realistic economy, and unique gameplay mechanics.

list.q: What are the basic RP rules?
list.a: Value your life, avoid RDM/VDM, stay in character, and always roleplay your actions realistically.

list.q: Can I play with my friends?
list.a: Of course! Just make sure all interactions follow RP rules and don’t break immersion for others.
Yes. You can earn money through legal and illegal jobs, purchase vehicles, properties and participate in various activities.

list.q: What should I do if I encounter a cheater?
list.a: Take a clip and report it on Discord in the proper section. Staff will handle it as fast as possible.
Yes, a working microphone is required for proper voice roleplay and server interactions.

list.q: Can I create a gang or organization?
list.a: Yes. You can apply for a gang slot through Discord. Approved groups receive custom tools and features.

list.q: What should I do if I find a bug?
list.a: Record it or describe it clearly and open a ticket on Discord. Developers will review and fix it asap.
